Order Details
This dashboard is a learning demo that loads the full Sample Superstore dataset (10,194 orders, 2021–2024) directly into the browser and computes every aggregation and cross-filter in client-side JavaScript. In a production environment, raw data should never be sent to the browser directly — only pre-aggregated results from a server/API layer should be delivered. The Manufacturer field is an approximation derived from the first word of each Product Name.
